name: manual_850cfd
claim: Before a restart-from-main, compare git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main with each run worktree HEAD and update a worktree only when the two SHAs differ; when they match, say plainly that nothing needed updating. Read related PR states for context, but never infer from an open PR that a repository's main has not moved: other merges can move main while a PR stays open. Do not trust a done claim, and name any open PR instead of reporting a refreshed stack.

decisions.notes: Review follow-up on PR 477: decide restarts from the ls-remote SHA versus each run worktree HEAD only; an open PR says nothing about whether main moved. The original graduated record stays unchanged and superseded.
